name: City Council Special Meeting - Oso Creek Trail Tour
minutes_text:
NOTICE OF ADJOURNMENT
  DUE TO LACK OF QUORUM

  Mission Viejo City Council, Planning and
  Transportation Commission, Investment Advisory
  Commission and Community Services Commission

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the joint/adjourned meeting of the Mission

Viejo City Council, Planning and Transportation Commission, Community

Services Commission, and the Investment Advisory Commission scheduled for

3:00 p.m. on Monday, September 19, 2011, was cancelled due to lack of a

quorum.

The above referenced meeting was adjourned to the next regularly scheduled

City Council meeting to be held on September 19, 2011, at 5:00 p.m. in the

Council Chamber at Mission Viejo City Hall, 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo,

California. Upcoming Commission Meetings will be held as regularly scheduled.

DATED: September 19, 2011

  CITY OF MISSION VIEJO

  __________________________
  Karen Hamman
  City Clerk
